key_features.classic_presentation: ONSET: Gradual over months to years. LOCATION: Bilateral, diffuse. DURATION: Chronic, persistent. CHARACTER: Progressive dyspnea, chest pain. AGGRAVATING: Exertion, infections. RELIEVING: Steroids, immunosuppressants. TIMING: Chronic, progressive. SEVERITY: Moderate to severe (5-8/10). ASSOCIATED SYMPTOMS: Progressive dyspnea, chest pain, fatigue, weight loss, skin lesions. KEY POSITIVES: Progressive dyspnea, chest pain, fatigue. KEY NEGATIVES: No fever (unless infection), no wheezing (unless reactive airway disease).
